title: South African Social Security Agency Act 9 of 2004
verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Title is 'South African Social Security Agency Act 9 of 2004'. Commencement: 15 November 2004, with s 4 on 1 April 2006.
notes: Sets up SASSA, the agency that administers and pays grants. It is institutional, so secondary to the Social Assistance Act.
